name: fix_headings
generation_system_prompt:
You will receive a list of section headings from a document. The heading levels may be wrong. Fix them:
- Document title: # (H1)
- Major sections (Introduction, Methods, Results, etc.): ## (H2)
- Subsections within a section: ### (H3)
- Sub-subsections: #### (H4)

Output ONLY the corrected headings, one per line, in the same order. Do not add or remove headings. Do not include anything else.
